index.description: Root directory to index in standalone mode; corresponds to -index=<root>

init.description: Extra initialization options in JSON string format; corresponds to -init=<string>

log_file.description: Path to log file; stderr if empty. Corresponds to -log-file=<file>

log_file_append.description: Whether to append to log file instead of truncating; corresponds to -log-file-append

test_index.description: Run index tests on given directory; corresponds to -test-index=<string>

verbosity.description: Verbosity level, from -3 (fatal) to 2 (verbose); corresponds to -v=<int>
